purpose: SSOT registry of collaborators on CYNIC-governed external projects. Trust is observed and promoted, never assumed.

collaborators.notes: Seed collaborator. Owns the three Aegis consortium repositories. Trust starts at 'observed'; promotion requires proof (mirrors CYNIC office/capability model in infra/registry.json).

rules: A new collaborator starts at 'observed' and cannot trigger mutations above 'read_only' until promoted with proof.
Promotion requires an observed proof record (commit, review, or attestation) referenced in notes.
Trust level is never inferred from GitHub handle or reputation; only from observed evidence.
